question.prompt:
The graph relates the distance traveled (in miles) to the time elapsed (in hours) on a trip taken by an experimental airplane. During which hour was the average speed of this airplane the largest?

[Figure 1](figures/1990_AMC_8_Q23_question_fig1.svg)

solutions.explanation:
Average speed is distance traveled divided by elapsed time. Since every choice describes one hour, we only need to compare how much the distance increases during each interval.

On the graph, compare the vertical rise between the two endpoints of each listed hour. The rise from \(1\) to \(2\) hours is slightly greater than the rise from \(0\) to \(1\) hour. The rises during the third, ninth, and last hours are all clearly smaller. Thus the greatest distance is traveled during the second hour, so the answer is \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
solutions.title: Compare the distance gained each hour
